description:
A dead camera on Kessler needs a part the Watch cannot make. Halloran has one put by, two streets over, behind a panel that has not been opened since the last time somebody needed it.

You ask who else makes them, since he has just finished saying the Watch does not.

"Three that I know of."

You wait for the names. They do not come, and he goes back to the bench.
name: Blind Spot

objectives.desc: Recover the camera core from the panel cache two streets over.
emotes: {who} gets the panel off without marking it, which is most of the job.
{who} finds the core exactly where a thing is when nobody has been at it.
{who} closes the panel and stands there a second, checking it looks unopened.
